sloka: सर्व रत्नमयैः चित्रैः अवगाढा नगोत्तमैः ।जातरूपमयैः च अपि हुताशन सम प्रभैः ॥४-४३-४३॥
transliteration: sarva ratnamayaiḥ citraiḥ avagāḍhā nagottamaiḥ ।jātarūpamayaiḥ ca api hutāśana sama prabhaiḥ ॥4-43-43॥

translations.english: 'There are tanks and lakes filled with lotuses shining like the rising Sun with lotus leaves having the colour of precious emeralds. The lotus filaments look like golden threads. The entire place is full of blue lotus groves, exquisite pearls and other gems.
translations.hindi: बड़े मूल्यवान रत्नों और सुत्रणलुल्य केसर वाले अद्भुत नोल कमल के फूलों के जंगल से बह देश चारों ओर से घिरा हुआ है
